author: @DisIngRaM
text:
The changes to story mode is great, but I think is not enough.
The problem with arc 2 unit is that, most of them completely overclass the Arc1 stages. It truly trivialize them, that even hard mode does not pose much difficulty for them.

I mean, look at the hard stage of ARC 1.
Compare them to Arc 2 normal story, the difficulty jump is drastic, that going back to even hard mode of ARC 1 felt like childs play.
Arc2 chapter 5 boss have straight 2 million HP and each turn survival is hard earned, no Arc 1 boss can contest to that..

The only way for new player to enjoy Arc 1 story, is simply inform them to only limit themself to only use Arc 1 unit (Which already received lots of buffs during arc 2 lifetime).
And I think the devs need to put limitations on Arc2 units when used on Arc1, if they want people to enjoy their Arc1.

author: @fubu72
text:
Thank you for the video actually, not everyone is crawling non stop inside every discord server they're part of.

The story mode change is nice although I even if the Hard mode enemies are higher levels a player might still have their awakeners way above them and it's difficult to balance. Some other games circumvent this entirely (and the possibility of overtuned characters) by giving you fixed teams and levels during story mode, which I think it's a better approach because you also give a lot of spotlight to the characters the current chapter is centered around.

Since my level was way to high by the point I was doing Chapter 2 of the first story arc I just kept Ramona, Ogier, Doll and Lotan underleveled to play the story with them, and it DOES work, although the team feels a bit simplistic after experiencing a full Aequor team on HSR or whatever, even after unlocking some of their extra skills. Watching Ramona use Queen's Blade 59 times in a row is pretty funny though.
